    c2=np.linalg.lstsq(B,f,rcond=None)[0]
    n=np.mean((f-B@c2)**2)/np.var(f)

def equation(t, x, v, params):
    return (params[0]*np.tanh(params[1]*t) + params[2]*t + params[3]
            + params[4]*v + params[5]*x*v + params[6]*x*x
            + params[7]*np.log(x) + params[8]*np.sqrt(v) + params[9]*x*v*v)
